operations.name: Marianne W. Fowler

expected.name: Marianne W. Fowler
expected.description: Marianne W. Fowler was a Virginia organizer for the Equal Rights Amendment. Capitol police arrested her on February 9, 1978 after a Virginia House committee voted to block the amendment and she joined a protest in the Capitol. She was charged with disorderly conduct, trespassing, and assault on an officer.

operations.name: Jean Marshall Clarke

expected.name: Jean Marshall Clarke
expected.description:
Jean Marshall Clarke was the Virginia coordinator of the National Organization for Women. Capitol police arrested her on February 9, 1978 during a protest after a Virginia House committee voted to block the Equal Rights Amendment. Witnesses reported that she went limp and was dragged from the Capitol grounds.

Photo: Bob Brown / Richmond Times-Dispatch, via Library of Virginia. Original-image crop; identified by the source (newspaper caption identifies Jean Marshall Clarke, foreground woman being arrested).
